name: pair_found
exact_derivation: request has a matched response (time-ordered, keyed by capture, endpoints, ports, transaction id)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'
leakage_risk: MEDIUM: capture-vantage artefact (e.g. one capture contains no responses) and exception replies appear only in attack captures

name: pair_status_code
exact_derivation: 0 matched, 1 exception, 2 missing, 3 out_of_order
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'
leakage_risk: MEDIUM: capture-vantage artefact (e.g. one capture contains no responses) and exception replies appear only in attack captures

name: response_missing
exact_derivation: 1 if no response found
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'
leakage_risk: MEDIUM: capture-vantage artefact (e.g. one capture contains no responses) and exception replies appear only in attack captures

name: unit_id_match
exact_derivation: response unit id == request unit id (-1 if no response)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: function_code_match
exact_derivation: response function == request function (-1 if no response)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: address_match
exact_derivation: write only, non-exception: response register == request register (-1 otherwise)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: quantity_match
exact_derivation: read only: response byte count == expected from request quantity (-1 otherwise)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: value_echo_match
exact_derivation: write only: response value == request value (-1 otherwise)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: response_delay
exact_derivation: response timestamp - request timestamp; -1 if no response
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'
leakage_risk: MEDIUM: capture-vantage artefact (e.g. one capture contains no responses) and exception replies appear only in attack captures

name: response_exception

name: access_combo_unseen
exact_derivation: 1 if (function, register) never seen as Normal in fold-training traffic
leakage_risk: HIGH: label rule uses the same (function, register) evidence (circular-labelling risk)

name: access_combo_normal_count_log
exact_derivation: log1p(count of the combo in fold-training Normal events)
leakage_risk: HIGH: label rule uses the same (function, register) evidence (circular-labelling risk)

name: access_write_unseen
exact_derivation: write whose (function, register) is unseen in fold-training Normal events
leakage_risk: HIGH: label rule uses the same (function, register) evidence (circular-labelling risk)

name: prev_value_same_ref
exact_derivation: previous written value for same register in the stream (-1 none)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: value_delta
exact_derivation: |value - previous value| same register (-1 none; clipped)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: value_changed
exact_derivation: value differs from previous value (-1 none)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: value_rate
exact_derivation: value_delta / seconds since previous write to the register (clipped)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'

name: value_outside_normal_range
exact_derivation: write value outside fold-training Normal min/max for that register (-1 if combo unseen)
missing_value_handling: -1 sentinel for not-applicable; fitted fill for 'no earlier event'
leakage_risk: HIGH: label rule uses the same (function, register) evidence (circular-labelling risk)
